trigger.description: A peer attempts to import or export mesh body, preview, embedding, tag, or metadata material outside its policy grants.
setup_commands: ee mesh peer add --workspace . --alias peer_mesh_metadata_only --tailscale-node-key <node-key> --endpoint <endpoint> --tailnet-id <tailnet-id> --public-key-fingerprint <fingerprint> --profile metadata-only --yes --json
trigger.invocation: ee mesh export --workspace . --peer peer_mesh_metadata_only --json   # export has no lane flag; the peer's profile decides what may leave
